title: PART 3 / THE SHOWDOWN
goal: Put learning into action through a shared challenge that develops communication, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.
outcomes: Contribute ideas and agree on a shared team plan.
Communicate and adapt while completing a creative challenge.
Explain one team decision and what they would try next.
prep_note: Before food activities, check school requirements, dietary needs, facilities, supervision, and cleanup.
focus: Notice how students share ideas and make one meaningful decision together.

rows.text: Introduce the chosen challenge and its shared team goal.
What will help everyone contribute to your team today?
Invite ideas, agree on an approach, and assign roles where helpful.
For food activities, check that the chosen materials and supervision are ready.
Paper cupcake, no food or kitchen. Sketch briefly, then combine ideas into one team design showing three teamwork qualities.

rows.description: One shared design sheet per team

rows.text: Premade cupcakes or craft alternative; no oven. Each person suggests an idea before the team chooses a shared plan.
Recipe and supervised oven. Teams agree on roles, then prepare and bake; allow extra time for oven capacity and cooling.
Baking plus one teacher-prepared constraint. Prefer a safe non-ingredient twist and discuss how the team will adapt.
Leave enough time to clean materials and stations safely; extend for baking.
Tune-In came before the challenge; Act happened during it. Now Share, Think Back, and Extend.
What decision helped your team, and what would you try next?

rows.description: Optional full written cycle; add about 10–15 min
